bestBets.overview: When a group 1 competitive 2yo is finishing 2nd in a maiden, it must be a hot race. So BOYS BOUNCE's 3rd here on debut (Zambales 2nd) has to be the right form. Love the way he found the line suggesting the 1500m should be suitable for him. SCAROLE is progressing well. He found trouble at the start on debut and was ok under the circumstances. Up to 1400m, he sat 3wide on pace and fought hard to be narrowly beaten. CAJUN showed enough on debut at Flemington. She's bred to be an Oaks/Wakeful filly. ZOUCITY started $31 on debut when he ran very well. 1500m should suit him. BOHEMIAN BOY is a likely improver up to 1500m.

raceTips.comment: Boys Bounce ran very well on debut over 1200m and looks well suited with the experience and up in trip. Much the same can be said for Zoucity who hit the line well over 1200m at Geelong in a strong Maiden. Scarole is fit and racing well and battled quite well last time, while Cajun resumes and merits consideration.

bestBets.overview: This is one of the better midweek benchmark stayers races of late. There are a stack of chances. LEONCHROI draws awkwardly but he's got the right man aboard. Keen to see him on a track that's on the better side of 6 and improving. He's going well and will be suited to 2400m now.  It was no shock to see PRESSURISED win as well as he did last time. He was coming off a good Saturday metro placing into a BM66. Dan Stackhouse gave him a good ride and he delivered. He beat CUSTOMER SERVICE who just doesn't run poorly. He gets right down in the weights. SHULTZY  just keeps on running well around this class of race.  His recent 2400m record is very good.  D-day is looming for AEOLIAN. Didn't think she was as good last time as the run prior. Perhaps it's 2400m that is the key. The stable had a couple of mares improve significantly at Caulfield Saturday. Wetter the better for WUDDZZ who found himself last time racing unusually close to the speed. There are probably  others with claims to winning.

raceTips.comment: An open enough race but Pressurised was impressive winning last time on Lakeside over this trip and may handle the rise in grade. Customer Service brings the same form and has been consistent. Go Daddy drops back in grade and showed improvement last time, while Stop The Clock is capable on his best form.
